ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) surface area with approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white) pixels localized at margins and as focal surface spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigmentation across both lobes. Discrete high-intensity pixel clusters are mapped to the distal tips and the perimeter of the trailing edge. Sparse, circular high-contrast blobs (rosettes) are distributed across the mid-sections of the lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a sharply defined vertex; depth is approximately 12-15% of the visible lobe vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing boundary, isolated clearly against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Marked concave curvature extending from the median notch to the distal tips; trailing edge geometry follows an upward-sweeping arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, irregular clusters of high-intensity pixel groups (barnacle colonies) at the lateral distal tips. Scattered circular high-contrast pixels (rosettes) present on the interior dark surfaces of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single distinct vertical linear disruption of white pixels (rake mark) visible on the interior region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified biological growth at both fluke tips, creating a highly textured, high-contrast irregular boundary.
